latest_release.name: v0.9.0
latest_release.body: ## Overview This release adds OCP FP8 E4M3 quantization support, a new `flash_attn_ext_rows` op that makes the unified KV cache efficient for multi-sequence inference, and a generic batched tensor copy API. Four new architectures are supported (Clover, Limite, Metis-1.6 and Mistral Large 4), audio generation and transcription expand with Chatterbox TTS, Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and predefined Pocket TTS voices, and the Gemma 4 E2B/E4B models get major prefill optimizations. `ggml` is updated to v0.29.0, bringing FP8 E4M3, flash attention rows, NCCL-based multi-node tensor parallelism and performance work across the CPU, CUDA, SYCL, Metal, Vulkan, OpenCL and Hexagon backends. The server and UI receive a round of fixes and refinements. ### Highlights - Quant: OCP FP8 E4M3 tensor type (saturating mode) with conversion helpers and a new ftype ([#27512](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27512)) - llama: `flash_attn_ext_rows` - more efficient unified KV for multi-seq, restoring non-unified KV prefill performance ([#29510](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29510)) - ggml: batched tensor copy API (`ggml_backend_tensor_copy_n`/`set_n`/`get_n`) superseding the `_2d` API, implemented for Metal and CUDA ([#30881](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30881)) - For a 3rd year in a row, `llama.cpp` is a featured repo in the [Github Octoverse report](https://github.blog/news-insights/octoverse/octoverse-commits-pushes-reach-new-highs-in-2026-as-developers-build-with-agents/): ### API changes - llama.h: add `LLAMA_FTYPE_MOSTLY_F8_E4M3` ([#27512](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27512)) - mtmd.h: add `MTMD_GEN_AUDIO_TYPE_CHATTERBOX` and `n_voices` to `mtmd_gen_audio_info` ([#30993](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30993)) - mtmd.h: add predefined-voice APIs: `mtmd_gen_audio_voice_name()`, `mtmd_gen_audio_get_voice()`, `mtmd_gen_state_set_ref()` ([#30993](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30993)) - mtmd.h: add `mtmd_bitmap_is_voice()` and `mtmd_gen_audio_read_tensor()` ([#30993](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30993)) - mtmd.h: add `MTMD_VIDEO_TEMPLATE_QWEN3VL` video prompt template ([#31619](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31619)) - server: `GET /props` reports the model's predefined TTS `voices`; the TTS endpoint accepts predefined voice names ([#30993](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30993)) - server: `/v1/responses` now merges `extra_params` (seed, min_p, ...) into the converted chat-completions response ([#30959](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30959)) ### New models - Clover-35B-A3B-Preview diffusion model, AR mode ([#31306](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31306)) - Limite 1B - Violetto ([#29433](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/29433)) - Metis-1.6 (Praxis ~2.9B and Logos ~10.2B): hybrid Mamba-2 / GQA attention with fixed-depth recurrence and LatentMoE ([#31134](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31134)) - Mistral Large 4 ([#31376](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31376)) ### Core changes - gemma4: graph optimizations with massive prefill gains for E2B and E4B ([#31356](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31356)); create `token_embd` before the tied output in gemma3n and gemma4 ([#31394](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31394)) - LFM3: enable NVFP4 GGUFs ([#31608](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31608)), enable tensor split ([#31431](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31431)), quantize the audio codec decoder ([#31386](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31386)) - spec dec: save and restore MTP hidden state in context checkpoints ([#30141](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/30141)) and record LFM3 layer inputs ([#31598](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/31598)) - dfla
